services.title: Full-stack product development
services.description: Have an idea, or a half-built product that needs to ship? I design and build web applications end to end: React on the front, Python and Node on the back, deployed on AWS. You get something real in users’ hands, not just a prototype.

services.title: AI implementation & solutions
services.description: AI is only worth it where it actually moves the needle. I bring LLMs into your product and workflows: copilots and chat, retrieval over your own data (RAG), agents, and automation. And I’ll tell you honestly where it helps and where it’s hype.

services.title: Salesforce & platform consulting
services.description: A decade of Salesforce delivery: Apex, Lightning Web Components, CPQ, integrations, and CI/CD. I extend and untangle complex orgs so the platform fits how your business actually sells and operates.

services.title: Fractional & advisory
services.description: Need senior engineering judgment without a full-time hire? I work as a fractional lead or technical advisor: architecture reviews, technical direction, and hands-on help getting a team unstuck and shipping.
